randomization: Release reviewer generates and escrows a fresh A/B mapping after freeze. Public deterministic packet order is not blinded.

usefulness: Directly useful and complete for the bounded task
groundedness: All claims precisely grounded with appropriate citations
brand_locale: Natural precise locale fit; preserves bilingual meaning
escalation: Correct bounded action or useful escalation
Correct escalation with concise useful next step

quality_gates.disagreement_resolution: Two bilingual reviewers score independently; any hard-failure disagreement or >=2-point difference requires recorded adjudication. Preserve original ratings.
quality_gates.missing_attempts: INCOMPLETE, never silently excluded from a denominator.
quality_gates.correction_effort: Record reviewer active-edit seconds and material-edit count; unavailable values stay null, not zero.

resource_proposal.memory_budget: TBD by isolated-model operator; no shared production capacity assumed
resource_proposal.latency_method: Measured wall-clock, nearest-rank p50/p95 per profile/language/arm with n; tail estimate is exploratory for small n. Report refusals/timeouts separately and include them in task success denominators.
resource_proposal.cost_method: Actual token use and isolated GPU wall-time; approved rate and currency or null with reason. Self-hosted does not mean zero operating cost.
